[{"sha":"eaca0ce913a1ea14aff0dbfae414825a31fc7a3c","node_id":"C_kwDOCv0SN9oAKGVhY2EwY2U5MTNhMWVhMTRhZmYwZGJmYWU0MTQ4MjVhMzFmYzdhM2M","commit":{"author":{"name":"Felix Zhang","email":"22125939+fan-zhang-sv@users.noreply.github.com","date":"2026-10-27T20:03:55Z"},"committer":{"name":"GitHub","email":"noreply@github.com","date":"2026-10-27T20:03:55Z"},"message":"feat(telemetry): measure every SDK surface (#1935)

* feat(telemetry): measure every SDK surface

Telemetry only covered sdk.evm requests, and the correlation id it logged
never reached the wallet. withMeasurement stored the id under the dapp's
request object, but core sends the wallet new objects, so the lookup always
missed.

- Pass the correlation id down. measureRequest gives each dapp request a
  transport that sends its id with every wallet message. The correlation-ids
  store is deleted.
- Measure sdk.connect() and the Solana wallet through provider.request.*,
  with a surface property (evm, solana, connect). Errors log errorCode.
- Log wallet.request.completed and .error for each popup round trip.
- Log session.cleared when a disconnect or a 4100 clears a saved session.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* refactor(telemetry): log wallet messages in measureRequest, rename surfaces

- Restore the popup transport's consume pattern. wallet.request.* is now
  logged by the transport measureRequest makes for each dapp request, so the
  popup transport only passes the correlation id through.
- Keep the provider's shared transport out of its request context, so each
  request's context gets that request's measured transport.
- Name surfaces for the interface the dapp called: eip1193_provider,
  wallet_standard, sdk_connect.
- Drop signerType: 'base-account'. It labeled this SDK's events as Base
  Account's; sdkName already tells the two apart.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* docs(transport): say why the correlation id is an argument

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* refactor(telemetry): drop wallet.request.* for one request rail

provider.request.* already says whether a dapp request reached the wallet:
signing methods always do on a connected session, and reads like
eth_chainId never do. A second rail per wallet message was confusing to
read next to it. measureRequest now only tags wallet messages with the
request's correlation id.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* refactor(eip1193): keep the transport in the provider's context

Each request still replaces it with the one measureRequest made, which carries the request's correlation id.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* refactor(eip1193): name the per-request transport measured

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* refactor(eip1193): measure provider requests with withMeasurement

withMeasurement binds a handler to the provider's context and measures every
call, running each on a copy of the context whose transport carries that
call's correlation id. The provider passes its context once and no longer
rebuilds it per request.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* refactor(telemetry): one withMeasurement for every request

measureRequest becomes withMeasurement and the EIP-1193-only wrapper is
gone. It creates the request's correlation id, builds a measuredTransport
that sends it with every wallet message, and logs provider.request.* around
the handler. Each caller passes measuredTransport where a transport is
needed: the provider into its context, Solana and sdk.connect() directly.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* feat(telemetry): log the picked EVM provider and the page's COOP

- provider.selected fires once per SDK when sdk.evm.getProvider() picks a
  provider, with providerKind: injected or sdk. Inside the Coinbase Wallet
  browser the injected provider answers every call, so this is the only
  event that shows how much traffic goes around the SDK's telemetry.
- communicator.popup_setup.started and .completed carry coop, the page's
  Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy. same-origin blocks the popup's messages, so
  it explains a setup that starts and never completes.
- Delete the sub_account_* dialog contexts and their actions, left over
  from the removed sub-account flows.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* revert(telemetry): drop coop from the popup setup events

The wallet already receives the page's Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy as the
coop search param on the popup URL.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

---------
